# Geodetic reference

## Geodetic reference

::: {.columns .config-slide}
::: {.column width="48%"}

#### Configuration file

::: {.config-path}

```text
config/
  wgs84_anchor.yaml
```

:::

#### Geographic anchor

```yaml
latitude: 45.76345967
longitude: 3.10955017
altitude: 351.9
```
:::

::: {.column width="52%"}

#### Configurable fields

::: {.config-table}

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `latitude` | WGS84 latitude of the local origin |
| `longitude` | WGS84 longitude of the local origin |
| `altitude` | WGS84 altitude of the local origin |

:::

#### Purposes

::: {.config-table}

| Used by | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| GPS plugins | Converts fixes to local ENU |
| Simulation | Aligns simulated GPS with the field |
| Trajectories | Shares the same metric origin |
| Localisation | Defines the robot-to-world frame |

:::
